title: Quality Manager: Gap Analysis
notice: Demo with sample data only. It is not connected to your organization's data, and it should not be.
question: Which synthetic quality measure has the largest evidence-review queue?

answer.question: Which synthetic quality measure has the largest evidence-review queue?
answer.answer: **SYN-COL** (colorectal screening) has the largest queue — 182 records needing evidence review out of 520, vs. 108 for SYN-BCS and 53 for SYN-CDC. All of these still need clinical/quality reviewer validation before any eligibility or exclusion decisions are made.
